text.id: Dewan Direksi punya 16 Direktur dengan hak suara dan empat liaison tanpa hak suara. Dewan mengawasi ICANN org dan mempertimbangkan rekomendasi kebijakan dari komunitas.
text.en: The Board has 16 voting Directors and four non-voting liaisons. It oversees the ICANN organization and considers policy recommendations from the community.

citations.quote: A globally diverse Board of Directors oversees the ICANN organization and considers community-developed policy recommendations. The Board has 16 voting members and four nonvoting liaison representatives.

text.id: Bylaws ICANN (anggaran dasar) menyerahkan pelaksanaan kekuasaan ICANN kepada Dewan, kecuali jika Articles of Incorporation atau Bylaws menentukan lain. Bisnis dan urusan ICANN dijalankan oleh Dewan atau di bawah arahannya.
text.en: The Bylaws give the exercise of ICANN's powers to the Board, unless the Articles of Incorporation or the Bylaws say otherwise. ICANN's business and affairs are run by the Board or under its direction.

citations.quote: the powers of ICANN shall be exercised by, and its property controlled and its business and affairs conducted by or under the direction of, the Board

text.id: Dewan memilih Chair dan Vice-Chair setiap tahun dari antara para Direktur, selain Presiden. Dewan juga memilih para officer ICANN setiap tahun: Presiden (yang menjabat sebagai CEO), Secretary, dan Chief Financial Officer.
text.en: The Board elects a Chair and a Vice-Chair each year from among the Directors, not counting the President. It also elects ICANN's officers each year: a President (who serves as CEO), a Secretary and a Chief Financial Officer.

citations.quote: The Board shall annually elect a Chair and a Vice-Chair from among the Directors, not to include the President.
The officers of ICANN shall be elected annually by the Board

text.id: Dewan dapat memberhentikan seorang officer, dengan atau tanpa alasan, lewat suara dua pertiga dari seluruh Direktur.
text.en: The Board can remove an officer, with or without cause, by a two-thirds vote of all Directors.

citations.quote: Any Officer may be removed, either with or without cause, by a two-thirds (2/3) majority vote of all Directors.

text.id: Dewan dapat memberhentikan seorang Direktur yang ditunjuk oleh Empowered Community tanpa alasan, dengan suara tiga perempat dari seluruh Direktur. Empowered Community kemudian wajib menyetujuinya tanpa pembahasan.
text.en: The Board can remove a Director designated by the Empowered Community without cause, by a three-fourths vote of all Directors. The Empowered Community must then consent without deliberation.

citations.quote: following notice to that Director, by a three-fourths (3/4) majority vote of all Directors
the EC shall without deliberation consent to such removal

text.id: Dewan dapat membentuk komite Dewan dan mendelegasikan kewenangannya kepada komite itu. Persetujuan ICANN Budget, IANA Budget, Operating Plan, dan Strategic Plan tidak boleh didelegasikan.
text.en: The Board can set up Board committees and delegate its authority to them. Approval of the ICANN Budget, the IANA Budget, the Operating Plan and the Strategic Plan cannot be delegated.

citations.quote: The Board may establish one or more committees of the Board
The approval of the ICANN Budget or IANA Budget required by Section 22.4 or the Operating Plan or Strategic Plan required by Section 22.5

text.id: Dewan terdiri atas 16 Direktur dengan hak suara. Delapan dinominasikan oleh Nominating Committee (Seat 1 sampai 8), dua oleh ASO, dua oleh ccNSO, dua oleh GNSO, dan satu oleh At-Large Community. Satu lagi adalah Presiden ICANN sebagai Direktur ex officio (Seat 16). Empat liaison (penghubung tanpa hak suara) dikirim oleh GAC, RSSAC, SSAC, dan IETF. Semua Direktur selain Presiden ditetapkan oleh Empowered Community.
text.en: The Board has 16 voting Directors. Eight are nominated by the Nominating Committee (Seats 1 to 8), two by the ASO, two by the ccNSO, two by the GNSO and one by the At-Large Community. The 16th is the ICANN President, an ex officio Director (Seat 16). Four non-voting liaisons are appointed by the GAC, RSSAC, SSAC and IETF. The Empowered Community designates every Director except the President.

citations.quote: The ICANN Board of Directors ("Board") shall consist of sixteen voting directors ("Directors").
Eight Directors nominated by the Nominating Committee to be designated as Directors by the EC.
In addition to the Directors designated by the EC, the President shall serve ex officio as a Director.
One appointed by the Governmental Advisory Committee;

text.id: Pada 3 Mei 2026 Dewan ICANN mengesahkan Resolusi 2026.05.03.14: Dewan mengizinkan Presiden dan CEO memberi kontribusi satu kali sebesar US$1.000.000 kepada Internet Governance Forum (IGF) pada tahun fiskal 2026. Dasarnya, ICANN diperkirakan punya dana surplus dibanding belanja operasionalnya. Pada 30 Oktober 2025, saat ICANN84 di Dublin, ICANN juga mengumumkan Tripti Sinha dipilih kembali sebagai Chair Dewan dan Sajid Rahman sebagai Vice Chair.
text.en: On 3 May 2026 the ICANN Board passed Resolution 2026.05.03.14: it authorized the President and CEO to make a one-time US$1,000,000 contribution to the Internet Governance Forum (IGF) in fiscal year 2026. The stated basis is that ICANN was forecast to have surplus funding compared with its operating expenses. Separately, on 30 October 2025, at ICANN84 in Dublin, ICANN announced that Tripti Sinha was reappointed Board Chair and Sajid Rahman was appointed Vice Chair.

citations.quote: the Board authorizes the President and CEO, or his designee(s), to provide a one-time, US$1,000,000 contribution to the IGF in FY26
ICANN is forecasted to have surplus funding as compared to operational expenses at the end of its fiscal year ending on 30 June 2026 (FY26)

the reappointment of Tripti Sinha as Chair of the ICANN Board of Directors and the appointment of Sajid Rahman as Vice Chair. Three new Board members will also be seated during the ICANN84 Annual General Meeting in Dublin

text.id: Setiap tahun Dewan menyampaikan panduan kepada Nominating Committee tentang karakteristik dan keahlian yang dibutuhkan untuk kursi Dewan. Dokumen tahun 2026 dipublikasikan di halaman NomCom.
text.en: Each year the Board gives the Nominating Committee guidance on the characteristics and skills it wants in Board members. The 2026 document is published on the NomCom page.

citations.locator: Board and Community Recommendations to NomCom, 2026
citations.quote: ICANN Board: Guidance from the ICANN Board to the Nominating Committee Regarding Important Characteristics and Skills for Board Members

text.id: ICANN org adalah staf ICANN di bawah Presiden dan CEO. Staf ini mendukung komunitas dan Dewan serta menerapkan kebijakan yang dikembangkan komunitas.
text.en: ICANN org is the ICANN staff led by the President and CEO. It supports the community and the Board and implements policies the community develops.

citations.locator: ICANN is made up of three parts: ICANN Organization
citations.quote: The ICANN organization provides staff and resources to support the ICANN community and Board, and implements policies developed by the community.
All other officers and staff shall report to the President or his or her delegate

text.id: ICANN org ada untuk memberi staf dan sumber daya bagi komunitas dan Dewan, dan untuk menerapkan kebijakan hasil komunitas. Bylaws menempatkan Presiden sebagai CEO yang memegang seluruh kegiatan dan bisnis ICANN.
text.en: ICANN org exists to give the community and Board staff and resources, and to implement community-developed policy. The Bylaws make the President the CEO, in charge of all of ICANN's activities and business.

citations.locator: ICANN is made up of three parts: ICANN Organization
citations.quote: The ICANN organization provides staff and resources to support the ICANN community and Board, and implements policies developed by the community.
The President shall be the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of ICANN in charge of all of its activities and business.

text.id: Staf menerapkan kebijakan yang dikembangkan komunitas, sedangkan pengembangan kebijakannya sendiri dilakukan komunitas, bukan staf.
text.en: Staff implement policies that the community develops. The community, not staff, does the policy development.

citations.locator: ICANN is made up of three parts: ICANN Organization
citations.quote: The ICANN organization provides staff and resources to support the ICANN community and Board, and implements policies developed by the community.

text.id: Seluruh officer lain dan staf melapor kepada Presiden atau orang yang ia tunjuk. Para officer dipilih Dewan setiap tahun, dan Dewan dapat memberhentikan mereka dengan suara dua pertiga dari seluruh Direktur.
text.en: All other officers and staff report to the President or a delegate. The Board elects the officers each year and can remove them by a two-thirds vote of all Directors.

citations.quote: All other officers and staff shall report to the President or his or her delegate, unless stated otherwise in these Bylaws.
Any Officer may be removed, either with or without cause, by a two-thirds (2/3) majority vote of all Directors.

text.id: ICANN menyediakan dukungan administratif dan operasional yang dibutuhkan Nominating Committee untuk menjalankan tugasnya.
text.en: ICANN provides the administrative and operational support the Nominating Committee needs to do its work.

citations.quote: ICANN shall provide administrative and operational support necessary for the Nominating Committee to carry out its responsibilities.

text.id: ICANN harus mempertahankan PTI sebagai badan hukum terpisah untuk menyediakan layanan IANA. ICANN adalah satu-satunya member PTI dan memilih direktur PTI.
text.en: ICANN must maintain PTI as a separate legal entity to provide IANA services. ICANN is PTI's sole member and elects its directors.

citations.quote: ICANN shall maintain as a separate legal entity a California nonprofit public benefit corporation (["PTI"]) for the purpose of providing IANA services
ICANN, in its capacity as the sole Member of PTI, shall elect the directors of PTI

text.id: Officer ICANN adalah Presiden (yang menjabat sebagai CEO), Secretary, dan Chief Financial Officer. Dewan boleh menambah officer lain. Presiden juga menjabat sebagai Direktur ex officio dengan hak suara penuh. Per Oktober 2026, halaman CEO Corner ICANN menyebut Kurtis Lindqvist sebagai Presiden dan CEO.
text.en: ICANN's officers are a President (who serves as CEO), a Secretary and a Chief Financial Officer. The Board may add other officers. The President also serves as an ex officio Director with full voting rights. As of October 2026, ICANN's CEO Corner page names Kurtis Lindqvist as President and CEO.

citations.quote: The officers of ICANN (each, an "Officer") shall be a President (who shall serve as Chief Executive Officer), a Secretary, and a Chief Financial Officer.
The President shall serve as an ex officio Director, and shall have all the same rights and privileges of any Director.
Kurt Erik “Kurtis” Lindqvist is the ICANN President and Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

text.id: Pada 10 Juni 2024 Dewan memilih Kurt Erik “Kurtis” Lindqvist sebagai Presiden dan CEO ICANN berikutnya. Sally Costerton tetap menjadi Presiden dan CEO sementara sampai ia mengambil alih pada Desember 2024.
text.en: On 10 June 2024 the Board selected Kurt Erik “Kurtis” Lindqvist as the next ICANN President and CEO. Sally Costerton stayed on as Interim President and CEO until he took over in December 2024.

citations.quote: The Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers (ICANN) Board of Directors has selected Kurt Erik “Kurtis” Lindqvist as the next ICANN President and Chief Executive Officer (CEO).
Sally Costerton will continue to serve as Interim President and CEO until Lindqvist takes over in December.

text.id: Badan di ICANN yang mengembangkan kebijakan untuk domain tingkat atas generik (gTLD) dan merekomendasikannya kepada Dewan Direksi ICANN.
text.en: The body inside ICANN that develops policy for generic top-level domains (gTLDs) and recommends it to the ICANN Board.

citations.quote: responsible for developing and recommending to the Board substantive policies relating to generic top-level domains

text.id: Bylaws ICANN (anggaran dasar) menetapkan GNSO sebagai badan pengembangan kebijakan yang bertugas mengembangkan dan merekomendasikan kepada Dewan kebijakan substantif tentang gTLD.
text.en: The ICANN Bylaws set up the GNSO as a policy-development body responsible for developing and recommending to the Board substantive policies on gTLDs.

citations.quote: There shall be a policy-development body known as the Generic Names Supporting Organization

text.id: GNSO Council mengelola proses pengembangan kebijakan (PDP) GNSO. Council menyusun GNSO Operating Procedures, yang harus disetujui mayoritas suara di setiap House.
text.en: The GNSO Council manages the GNSO policy development process (PDP). It writes the GNSO Operating Procedures, which need a majority vote of each House.

citations.quote: The GNSO Council is responsible for managing the policy development process of the GNSO.
provided that such procedures are approved by a majority vote of each House

text.id: Ambang suara berbeda untuk tiap keputusan. Memulai PDP dalam lingkup butuh lebih dari sepertiga suara di setiap House atau lebih dari dua pertiga di satu House. "GNSO Supermajority" berarti dua pertiga di setiap House, atau tiga perempat di satu House ditambah mayoritas di House lainnya.
text.en: Voting thresholds differ by decision. Starting a PDP within scope needs more than one-third of each House or more than two-thirds of one House. A "GNSO Supermajority" is two-thirds of each House, or three-fourths of one House plus a majority of the other.

citations.quote: requires an affirmative vote of more than one-third (1/3) of each House or more than two-thirds (2/3) of one House.
two-thirds (2/3) of the Council members of each House, or (B) three-fourths (3/4) of the Council members of one House and a majority of the Council members of the other House.

text.id: Tiap House memilih satu calon untuk kursi Dewan ICANN: Contracted Parties House untuk Kursi 13 dan Non-Contracted Parties House untuk Kursi 14. Pencalonan butuh 60% suara dari seluruh anggota House tersebut.
text.en: Each voting House nominates one person for an ICANN Board seat: the Contracted Parties House for Seat 13 and the Non-Contracted Parties House for Seat 14. A nomination needs 60% of all members of that House.

citations.quote: any such nomination must have affirmative votes compromising sixty percent (60%) of all the respective voting House members
the Non-Contracted Parties House (as described in Section 11.3(h)(ii)) shall select a representative to fill Seat 14.

text.id: GNSO ikut dalam Empowered Community sebagai Decisional Participant. Bylaws mengatur ambang suara GNSO untuk tiap tindakan, misalnya GNSO Supermajority untuk mendukung petisi pencopotan Direktur.
text.en: The GNSO takes part in the Empowered Community as a Decisional Participant. The Bylaws set GNSO voting thresholds per action, for example a GNSO Supermajority to approve a petition to remove a Director.

citations.quote: The voting thresholds described below shall apply to the following GNSO actions as a Decisional Participant in the Empowered Community.

text.id: GNSO Council punya 21 kursi: 3 dari Registries Stakeholder Group, 3 dari Registrars Stakeholder Group, 6 dari Commercial Stakeholder Group, 6 dari Non-Commercial Stakeholder Group, dan 3 dari Nominating Committee (satu tanpa hak suara). Untuk pemungutan suara, Council terbagi dua House: Contracted Parties House (7 suara) dan Non-Contracted Parties House (13 suara).
text.en: The GNSO Council has 21 seats: 3 from the Registries Stakeholder Group, 3 from the Registrars Stakeholder Group, 6 from the Commercial Stakeholder Group, 6 from the Non-Commercial Stakeholder Group, and 3 from the Nominating Committee (one non-voting). For voting, it splits into two Houses: the Contracted Parties House (7 votes) and the Non-Contracted Parties House (13 votes).

citations.quote: three representatives selected by the ICANN Nominating Committee, one of which shall be non-voting
for a total of seven voting members
for a total of thirteen voting members

text.id: PDP New gTLD Subsequent Procedures (SubPro) dimulai Council pada Desember 2015. Pada 24 Maret 2021 Council mengirim rekomendasi akhirnya ke Dewan. Pada 16 Maret 2023 Dewan menyetujui Scorecard secara penuh: sebagian hasil diadopsi, sebagian ditetapkan "pending".
text.en: The New gTLD Subsequent Procedures (SubPro) PDP was initiated by the Council in December 2015. On 24 March 2021 the Council sent its final recommendations to the Board. On 16 March 2023 the Board adopted the Scorecard in full: some outputs were adopted and others designated pending.

citations.locator: Background text on the PDP page
citations.quote: Subsequently, the GNSO Council initiated the Policy Development Process (PDP) in December 2015 and adopted the working group charter in January 2016.

citations.locator: Whereas clause on the SubPro Final Report
citations.quote: transmitted its Recommendations Report regarding adoption of the final recommendations (Recommendations) from the New gTLD Subsequent Procedures Policy Development Process to the ICANN Board
the ICANN Board adopts the Scorecard in full. Section A of the Scorecard identifies the Outputs that the Board adopts. Section B identifies the Outputs that the Board designates as pending.

text.id: Siapa saja pada umumnya boleh bergabung dengan Working Group GNSO. Pendaftaran lewat ICANN Join di ICANN Account, dan waktu terbaik adalah saat grup baru dibentuk.
text.en: In general, anyone can join a GNSO Working Group. Sign up through ICANN Join on an ICANN Account, ideally when the group is being formed.

citations.quote: In general, anyone can join a GNSO Working Group or Drafting Team.

text.id: Kelompok yang belum terwakili dapat mengajukan petisi ke Dewan agar diakui sebagai Constituency baru di Non-Contracted Parties House.
text.en: A group that is not yet represented can petition the Board to be recognized as a new Constituency in the Non-Contracted Parties House.

citations.quote: Any group of individuals or entities may petition the Board for recognition as a new or separate Constituency in the Non-Contracted Parties House.

text.id: Empat stakeholder group (kelompok pemangku kepentingan) di dalam GNSO, terbagi dalam dua House, yang masing-masing memilih anggota GNSO Council.
text.en: Four stakeholder groups inside the GNSO, split between two Houses, each of which selects members of the GNSO Council.

citations.quote: Four Stakeholder Groups organized within Houses as described in Section 11.5;

text.id: Dewan ICANN mendorong GNSO menyusun Council berdasarkan stakeholder group yang luas, agar beragam kelompok dan individu di komunitas ICANN terwakili.
text.en: The ICANN Board encouraged the GNSO to structure its Council around broad stakeholder groups, so that the wide variety of groups and individuals in the ICANN community is represented.

citations.locator: Stakeholder Groups and Constituencies, opening paragraph
citations.quote: The ICANN Board encouraged the GNSO to structure its Council on the basis of broad Stakeholder Groups in order to represent the wide variety of groups and individuals in the ICANN community.

text.id: Tiap stakeholder group mengisi kursi GNSO Council: Registries 3, Registrars 3, Commercial 6, Non-Commercial 6. Dua kelompok pertama membentuk Contracted Parties House, dua lainnya Non-Contracted Parties House. Nominating Committee menambah satu anggota bersuara di setiap House.
text.en: Each stakeholder group fills seats on the GNSO Council: Registries 3, Registrars 3, Commercial 6, Non-Commercial 6. The first two form the Contracted Parties House and the other two the Non-Contracted Parties House. The Nominating Committee adds one voting member to each House.

citations.quote: the Registries Stakeholder Group (three members), the Registrars Stakeholder Group (three members), and one voting member appointed by the ICANN Nominating Committee for a total of seven voting members

the Commercial Stakeholder Group (six members), the Non-Commercial Stakeholder Group (six members), and one voting member appointed by the ICANN Nominating Committee to that House for a total of thirteen voting members

text.id: Masing-masing mewakili kepentingan tertentu: Registries SG mewakili semua registry gTLD yang berkontrak dengan ICANN, Registrars SG mewakili semua registrar terakreditasi yang berkontrak dengan ICANN, Commercial SG mewakili entitas komersial besar dan kecil, dan Non-Commercial SG mewakili entitas nonkomersial.
text.en: Each represents a defined interest: the Registries SG all gTLD registries under contract to ICANN, the Registrars SG all accredited registrars under contract to ICANN, the Commercial SG large and small commercial entities, and the Non-Commercial SG non-commercial entities.

citations.quote: Registries Stakeholder Group representing all gTLD registries under contract to ICANN;
Registrars Stakeholder Group representing all registrars accredited by and under contract to ICANN;
Commercial Stakeholder Group representing the full range of large and small commercial entities of the Internet
Non-Commercial Stakeholder Group representing the full range of non-commercial entities of the Internet.

text.id: Dua stakeholder group tersusun dari constituency, total lima. Commercial SG memiliki Business Constituency, Intellectual Property Constituency, dan Internet Service Providers and Connectivity Providers Constituency. Dua lainnya berada di Non-Commercial SG: Non-Commercial Users Constituency dan Not-for-Profit Organizations Constituency.
text.en: Two stakeholder groups are made up of constituencies, five in total. The Commercial SG has the Business Constituency, the Intellectual Property Constituency, and the Internet Service Providers and Connectivity Providers Constituency. The other two sit in the Non-Commercial SG: the Non-Commercial Users Constituency and the Not-for-Profit Organizations Constituency.

citations.locator: Stakeholder Groups and Constituencies, intro paragraphs
citations.quote: Membership information and the leadership teams of the four Stakeholder Groups and five Constituencies are available in the following links:
which includes the Business Constituency ("Business Constituency"), Intellectual Property Constituency ("Intellectual Property Constituency")

text.id: Setiap stakeholder group dan constituency harus mempertahankan pengakuan dari Dewan ICANN. Dewan menafsirkan ketentuan ini sebagai keharusan menyetujui setiap perubahan piagam (charter) mereka.
text.en: Each stakeholder group and constituency must maintain recognition with the ICANN Board. The Board has read this to mean it must approve any change to their charters.

citations.quote: shall maintain recognition with the ICANN Board.

citations.locator: Process for Amending GNSO Stakeholder Group and Constituency Charters
citations.quote: The ICANN Board has interpreted this language to require its approval of any GNSO charter amendments.

text.id: Contracted Parties House berisi Registries SG dan Registrars SG, yaitu pihak yang berkontrak dengan ICANN. Non-Contracted Parties House berisi Commercial SG dan Non-Commercial SG. Keanggotaan diatur piagam masing-masing. Registries SG, misalnya, terdiri dari operator registry yang berkontrak dengan ICANN dan memilih bergabung secara sukarela.
text.en: The Contracted Parties House holds the Registries SG and the Registrars SG, the parties that hold contracts with ICANN. The Non-Contracted Parties House holds the Commercial SG and the Non-Commercial SG. Membership rules sit in each group's charter. The Registries SG, for example, is made up of registry operators under contract with ICANN who choose to join.

citations.quote: the GNSO Council (see Section 11.3(a)) shall be organized into a bicameral House structure
(i) that are currently under contract with ICANN to provide gTLD registry services in support of one or more gTLDs
Membership to the CSG is coordinated through membership with one of its Constituencies.

text.id: Charter Registrar Stakeholder Group diadopsi anggotanya pada 27 Juni 2018 dan disetujui Dewan ICANN pada 23 Juni 2019. Contoh ini menunjukkan alurnya: grup menulis charter sendiri, lalu Dewan menyetujuinya.
text.en: The Registrar Stakeholder Group charter was adopted by its members on 27 June 2018 and approved by the ICANN Board on 23 June 2019. It shows the pattern: the group writes its own charter, then the Board approves it.

citations.quote: Registrar Stakeholder Group Charter | Adopted by the RrSG on 27 June 2018 and formally approved by the ICANN Board on 23 June 2019.
the four Stakeholder Groups and the Constituencies will be responsible for defining their own charters with the approval of their members and of the Board.

text.id: Registrar dan operator registry dapat bergabung lewat situs grup masing-masing (rrsg.org untuk registrar, rysg.info untuk registry).
text.en: Registrars and registry operators can join through each group's own site (rrsg.org for registrars, rysg.info for registries).

citations.quote: More information about the RrSG including how to join can be found at https://www.rrsg.org
More information about the RySG including how to join can be found at http://www.rysg.info/

text.id: Organisasi nonkomersial, serta individu yang mendaftarkan domain untuk keperluan pribadi nonkomersial, dapat mendaftar ke Non-Commercial Stakeholder Group lewat wiki NCSG.
text.en: Non-commercial organizations, and individuals who register domain names for non-commercial personal use, can apply to the Non-Commercial Stakeholder Group through the NCSG wiki.

citations.quote: Membership information on how to join the NCSG can be found on the NCSG Wiki that includes a direct link to the NCSG Membership Application.
families or individuals who register domain names for noncommercial personal use

text.id: Badan di ICANN yang dibentuk oleh dan untuk pengelola domain kode negara (ccTLD). Ia mengembangkan kebijakan global ccTLD dan merekomendasikannya ke Dewan ICANN.
text.en: The ICANN body made by and for country-code TLD (ccTLD) managers. It develops global ccTLD policy and recommends it to the Board.

citations.quote: The ccNSO is a body within the ICANN structure created for and by ccTLD managers.

text.id: Bylaws menetapkan ccNSO sebagai badan pengembangan kebijakan yang bertugas mengembangkan dan merekomendasikan kepada Dewan kebijakan global tentang ccTLD, dan mencalonkan orang untuk Kursi 11 dan 12 di Dewan.
text.en: The Bylaws set up the ccNSO as a policy-development body responsible for developing and recommending global ccTLD policy to the Board, and for nominating people to Board Seats 11 and 12.

citations.quote: developing and recommending to the Board global policies relating to country-code top-level domains;
Nominating individuals to fill Seats 11 and 12 on the Board;

text.id: ccNSO mengembangkan kebijakan lewat ccNSO Policy-Development Process (ccPDP) di Annex B Bylaws, dalam lingkup yang dibatasi Annex C. Kebijakan yang mengikat anggota hanya yang lahir dari proses ini dan disetujui Dewan.
text.en: The ccNSO develops policy through the ccNSO Policy-Development Process (ccPDP) in Annex B of the Bylaws, within the scope set by Annex C. Policies bind members only if they come out of this process and the Board adopts them.

citations.quote: Policies that apply to ccNSO members by virtue of their membership are only those policies developed according to Section 10.4(j) and Section 10.4(k).
the ccNSO shall follow the ccNSO Policy-Development Process

text.id: Di luar kebijakan resmi, anggota dapat menjalankan kegiatan sukarela, seperti menyusun praktik terbaik bagi pengelola ccTLD dan membangun keterampilan komunitas pengelola ccTLD.
text.en: Outside formal policy, members can run voluntary activities, such as developing best practices for ccTLD managers and building skills across the ccTLD manager community.

citations.quote: such activities may include: seeking to develop voluntary best practices for ccTLD managers, assisting in skills building within the global community of ccTLD managers

text.id: ccNSO Council mencalonkan dua orang untuk Kursi 11 dan 12 di Dewan ICANN. Pencalonan butuh suara mayoritas dari seluruh anggota Council yang menjabat.
text.en: The ccNSO Council nominates two people for ICANN Board Seats 11 and 12. A nomination needs a majority of all Council members in office.

citations.quote: any such nomination must have affirmative votes of a majority of all the members of the ccNSO Council then in office

text.id: ccNSO adalah Decisional Participant di Empowered Community, yang memegang kewenangan pengawasan atas ICANN.
text.en: The ccNSO is a Decisional Participant in the Empowered Community, which holds oversight powers over ICANN.

citations.locator: How Is the Work of the ccNSO Organized?, item 5
citations.quote: The ccNSO is a Decisional Participant in the Empowered Community (EC), which has oversight powers over ICANN.

text.id: Anggota ccNSO adalah pengelola ccTLD yang menyatakan setuju secara tertulis; bergabung bersifat sukarela. ccNSO Council punya 15 anggota terpilih (3 dari tiap 5 Wilayah Geografis ICANN) dan 3 anggota yang dipilih Nominating Committee. Penghubung tanpa hak suara dapat datang dari GAC, ALAC, dan organisasi regional ccTLD.
text.en: ccNSO members are ccTLD managers that agreed in writing to join; joining is voluntary. The ccNSO Council has 15 elected members (3 from each of ICANN's 5 Geographic Regions) and 3 selected by the Nominating Committee. Non-voting liaisons can come from the GAC, the ALAC, and the regional ccTLD organizations.

citations.quote: ccTLD managers that have agreed in writing to be members of the ccNSO

citations.locator: How Is the Work of the ccNSO Organized?, item 2
citations.quote: It has 15 elected members (3 from each of the 5 ICANN geographic regions) and 3 members appointed by the ICANN’s Nominating Committee (NomCom).

There shall also be one liaison to the ccNSO Council from each of the following organizations, to the extent they choose to appoint such a liaison: (i) the Governmental Advisory Committee; (ii) the At-Large Advisory Committee;

text.id: Kebijakan pemensiunan ccTLD (ccPDP3). Anggota ccNSO mendukungnya pada 2021: dari 172 anggota, 100 memberi suara dan 94 setuju. Dewan ICANN mengadopsinya pada 22 September 2022 (Resolusi 2022.09.22.09). Kebijakan ini mengatur penghapusan ccTLD yang dipensiunkan dari root zone lima tahun setelah pemberitahuan. Contoh lain yang dekat dengan pembaca Indonesia adalah .id. Basis data Root Zone IANA mengklasifikasikannya sebagai country-code top-level domain, dengan manajer Perkumpulan Pengelola Nama Domain Internet Indonesia (PANDI). Basis data yang sama mencantumkan laporan redelegasi .ID kepada PANDI tertanggal 24 Mei 2013.
text.en: The ccTLD retirement policy (ccPDP3). ccNSO members supported it in 2021: of 172 members, 100 voted and 94 were in favor. The ICANN Board adopted it on 22 September 2022 (Resolution 2022.09.22.09). The policy sets removal of a retiring ccTLD from the root zone five years after notice. A closer example for Indonesian readers is .id. The IANA Root Zone Database classifies it as a country-code top-level domain, with Perkumpulan Pengelola Nama Domain Internet Indonesia (PANDI) as manager. The same entry lists the report on the redelegation of .ID to PANDI, dated 24 May 2013.

citations.quote: out of 172 members, 100 voted (58%), of which 94 were in favor and 6 were not.
the Board adopts the ccNSO Retirement of ccTLDs Policy Recommendations as set forth in Attachment A, sections 1-5 of the Board Report

citations.locator: Summary of the policy, Notice of Removal
citations.quote: the ccTLD shall be removed from the Root Zone five years from the date of the notice.
Country-code top-level domain
Manager Perkumpulan Pengelola Nama Domain Internet Indonesia (PANDI)

text.id: Pengelola ccTLD dapat menjadi anggota lewat formulir daring dan akun ICANN. Keanggotaan terbuka bagi pengelola ccTLD kode negara ISO 3166-1 dan pengelola IDN ccTLD. Permohonan diverifikasi IANA dan disetujui ccNSO Council.
text.en: ccTLD managers can join through an online form and an ICANN Account. Membership is open to managers of ISO 3166-1 country-code TLDs and to IDN ccTLD managers. Applications are checked by IANA and approved by the ccNSO Council.

citations.quote: Membership of the ccNSO is open to ccTLD managers responsible for managing an ISO 3166-1 country code top-level domain, as well as interested IDN ccTLD managers.
verification checks by IANA, and a formal approval of your membership application by the ccNSO Council

text.id: Pertemuan tahunan anggota ccNSO terbuka bagi umum. Pengelola ccTLD yang bukan anggota dan pihak lain berhak mendapat kesempatan berbicara.
text.en: The annual meeting of ccNSO members is open to all. ccTLD managers who are not members, and other non-members, get a reasonable opportunity to address it.

citations.quote: a reasonable opportunity shall be provided for ccTLD managers that are not members of the ccNSO as well as other non-members of the ccNSO to address the meeting

text.id: Satu dari tiga Supporting Organization ICANN. ASO menyampaikan nasihat kepada Dewan tentang kebijakan alamat IP; Number Resource Organization (NRO) menjalankan fungsinya.
text.en: One of ICANN's three Supporting Organizations. The ASO advises the Board on IP address policy, and the Number Resource Organization (NRO) carries out its functions.

citations.quote: The ASO is one of ICANN’s three Supporting Organizations (SOs).
fulfils the role, responsibilities and functions of the ASO.

text.id: Bylaws menetapkan bahwa ASO menasihati Dewan tentang kebijakan terkait pengoperasian, penugasan, dan pengelolaan alamat Internet. ASO dibentuk lewat MoU antara ICANN dan NRO tertanggal 21 Oktober 2004; naskah MoU yang berlaku sekarang tertanggal 7 November 2019.
text.en: The Bylaws say the ASO advises the Board on policy issues relating to the operation, assignment, and management of Internet addresses. It was established by an MoU between ICANN and the NRO dated 21 October 2004; the current MoU text is dated 7 November 2019.

citations.quote: shall advise the Board with respect to policy issues relating to the operation, assignment, and management of Internet addresses.
The ASO shall be the entity established by the Memorandum of Understanding entered on 21 October 2004 between ICANN and the Number Resource Organization
Address Supporting Organization (ASO) Memorandum of Understanding 2019

text.id: ASO punya peran dalam proses kebijakan global (GPDP). Usulan kebijakan global harus lebih dulu disetujui dalam proses kebijakan di kelima RIR dengan teks yang identik. Address Council lalu memeriksa proses persetujuan itu dan meneruskannya ke Dewan ICANN untuk diratifikasi sebagai kebijakan global.
text.en: The ASO has a role in the global policy development process (GPDP). A global policy proposal must first be ratified, in identical form, through the policy process in each of the five RIRs. The Address Council then reviews how it was ratified and passes it to the ICANN Board for ratification as a global policy.

citations.quote: The ASO AC reviews the process by which the global policy proposal was ratified and, as outlined in Attachment A of the ASO MoU, passes it to the ICANN Board of Directors for ratification as a global policy.

text.id: Kebijakan global mengatur cara Public Technical Identifiers (PTI), pelaksana fungsi IANA, menyalurkan sumber daya nomor Internet ke para RIR. Para RIR lalu membagikannya ke anggota sesuai kebijakan regional.
text.en: Global policies govern how Public Technical Identifiers (PTI), which performs the IANA functions, issues Internet number resources to the RIRs. The RIRs then distribute them to their members under regional policies.

citations.quote: Global policies govern how Public Technical Identifiers (PTI), the organization charged with performing the IANA functions, issues Internet number resources to the RIRs.

text.id: Address Council mencalonkan orang untuk Kursi 9 dan 10 di Dewan ICANN, dan memberi Dewan rekomendasi tentang pengakuan RIR baru.
text.en: The Address Council nominates people for ICANN Board Seats 9 and 10, and gives the Board recommendations on recognizing new RIRs.

citations.quote: The Address Council shall nominate individuals to fill Seats 9 and 10 on the Board.
Provides recommendations to the ICANN Board concerning the recognition of new RIRs.

text.id: Dalam Empowered Community, NRO berpartisipasi sebagai ASO.
text.en: In the Empowered Community, the NRO takes part as the ASO.

citations.quote: participates, as the ASO, in the ICANN Empowered Community.

text.id: Address Council (ASO AC) terdiri atas 15 anggota NRO Number Council, yaitu tiga dari tiap RIR: dua dipilih komunitas RIR dan satu ditunjuk Executive Board RIR. ASO dan NRO adalah dua badan terpisah: NRO, sebagai badan koordinasi lima RIR, menjalankan fungsi ASO.
text.en: The Address Council (ASO AC) is the 15 members of the NRO Number Council: three from each RIR, two chosen by the RIR's community and one appointed by the RIR's Executive Board. The ASO and the NRO are separate bodies: the NRO, as the coordinating body of the five RIRs, carries out the ASO's functions.

citations.quote: The ASO shall have an Address Council, consisting of the members of the NRO Number Council.
Each of the five RIRs appoints three members to the ASO AC. Each RIR’s community appoints two members and one member is appointed by the RIR’s Executive Board.
The Address Supporting Organization (ASO) and the Number Resource Organization (NRO) are two separate bodies.

text.id: Global Policy for Post Exhaustion IPv4 Allocation Mechanisms by the IANA, diratifikasi pada Mei 2012. Kebijakan ini menetapkan kriteria alokasi ruang alamat IPv4 dari IANA ke para RIR.
text.en: The Global Policy for Post Exhaustion IPv4 Allocation Mechanisms by the IANA, ratified in May 2012. It sets the criteria for allocating IPv4 address space from the IANA to the RIRs.

citations.quote: Global Policy for Post Exhaustion IPv4 Allocation Mechanisms by the IANA
Criteria governing the allocation of IPv4 address space from the IANA to the RIRs

text.id: Siapa pun, di mana pun, boleh mengusulkan kebijakan global. Usulan itu masuk lebih dulu ke proses kebijakan di kelima RIR.
text.en: Anyone, anywhere can propose a global policy. The proposal goes first through the policy process in each of the five RIRs.

citations.quote: Anyone, anywhere can propose a global policy.

text.id: Komunitas tiap RIR memilih dua anggota Address Council lewat proses pencalonan dan pemilihan yang terbuka di wilayah masing-masing. Rapat bulanan Address Council terbuka bagi pengamat.
text.en: Each RIR community elects two Address Council members through open nomination and election processes in its region. The Address Council's monthly teleconferences are open to observers.

citations.quote: Each RIR community appoints their two ASO AC members through open and transparent nomination and election processes in their respective regions.
holds monthly teleconferences, which are open to observers.

text.id: ALAC adalah wadah utama di ICANN bagi pengguna internet individu dan memberi nasihat tentang kegiatan ICANN yang menyangkut kepentingan mereka.
text.en: The ALAC is ICANN's main home for individual Internet users and advises on ICANN activities that affect their interests.

citations.quote: the primary organizational home within ICANN for individual Internet users. The role of the ALAC shall be to consider and provide advice on the activities of ICANN, insofar as they relate to the interests of individual Internet users.

text.id: Bylaws ICANN (anggaran dasar) menetapkan ALAC untuk menimbang dan memberi nasihat tentang kegiatan ICANN yang berkaitan dengan kepentingan pengguna internet individu. Itu mencakup kebijakan yang dibuat Supporting Organization (SO) dan isu lain yang butuh masukan komunitas.
text.en: The ICANN Bylaws give the ALAC the role of considering and advising on ICANN activities that relate to individual Internet users. That covers policies made by the Supporting Organizations (SOs) and other issues where community input is appropriate.

citations.quote: This includes policies created through ICANN's Supporting Organizations, as well as the many other issues for which community input and advice is appropriate.

text.id: Menyusun dan menyampaikan pernyataan, komentar, dan nasihat resmi tentang kebijakan ICANN. Pernyataan ALAC lewat tahapan tetap: draf pertama, komentar, draf akhir, pemungutan suara ALAC, lalu penyerahan.
text.en: Writes and submits statements, comments, and formal advice on ICANN policy. An ALAC statement goes through set phases: first draft, comment period, final draft, ALAC vote, then submission.

citations.quote: The At-Large Advisory Committee participates in many activities leading to it issuing including statements, comments, correspondences, proposals, briefings, declarations and formal advice on ICANN policies and issues impacting Internet users.
Phase 4 . ALAC Vote

text.id: Bersama RALO, mengoordinasikan pencalonan orang untuk kursi Dewan nomor 15. ALAC Chair memberi tahu EC Administration secara tertulis, dan Empowered Community (EC) kemudian menindaklanjutinya.
text.en: Works with the RALOs to coordinate nominations for Board Seat 15. The ALAC Chair notifies the EC Administration in writing, and the Empowered Community (EC) then acts on it.

citations.quote: Nominating individuals to fill Seat 15 on the Board.

text.id: Setiap tahun menunjuk lima delegate dengan hak suara ke Nominating Committee (NomCom). Tidak ada dua delegate yang boleh berasal dari wilayah geografis yang sama.
text.en: Each year appoints five voting delegates to the Nominating Committee (NomCom). No two of them may be citizens of countries in the same Geographic Region.

citations.quote: annually appoint five voting delegates (no two of whom shall be citizens of countries in the same Geographic Region) to the Nominating Committee.

text.id: Mengesahkan organisasi sebagai At-Large Structure (ALS), dengan saran dan keterlibatan RALO tempat pelamar berada. Keputusan sertifikasi atau pencabutan diatur dalam rules of procedure ALAC.
text.en: Certifies organizations as At-Large Structures (ALSes), with the advice and participation of the RALO where the applicant is based. Decisions to certify or decertify follow the ALAC's rules of procedure.

citations.quote: the ALAC, with the advice and participation of the RALO where the applicant is based, shall be responsible for certifying organizations as meeting the criteria and standards for At-Large Structure accreditation.

text.id: ALAC punya 15 anggota dengan hak suara: 2 dipilih tiap RALO (total 10) dan 5 dipilih NomCom, satu dari tiap wilayah geografis ICANN. Ketua dipilih oleh anggota ALAC sendiri.
text.en: The ALAC has 15 voting members: 2 selected by each RALO (10 in total) and 5 selected by the NomCom, one citizen from each of the five ICANN Geographic Regions. The members elect the Chair.

citations.quote: two members selected by each of the Regional At-Large Organizations
five members selected by the Nominating Committee. The five members selected by the Nominating Committee shall include one citizen of a country within each of the five Geographic Regions
There are 15 ALAC Members, who have the voting power within the ALAC:
The Chair of the ALAC shall be elected by the members of the ALAC pursuant to procedures adopted by the ALAC.

text.id: ALAC Statement on DNS Abuse Mitigation PDP1 Initial Report: tanggapan ALAC atas laporan awal proses pengembangan kebijakan tentang DNS abuse. ALAC memberi suara pada 25 September 2026 dan pernyataan itu diserahkan pada 28 September 2026.
text.en: ALAC Statement on DNS Abuse Mitigation PDP1 Initial Report: the ALAC's response to the initial report of the policy development process on DNS abuse. The ALAC vote ended on 25 September 2026 and the statement was submitted on 28 September 2026.

citations.quote: ALAC Statement on DNS Abuse Mitigation PDP1 Initial Report
ALAC Statement on DNS Abuse Mitigation PDP1 Initial Report Status: Submitted 28 Sep 2026

text.id: Siapa pun bisa masuk komunitas At-Large dengan bergabung ke At-Large Structure (ALS) yang sudah terakreditasi. Anggota ALS otomatis menjadi anggota komunitas At-Large.
text.en: Anyone can enter the At-Large community by joining an accredited At-Large Structure (ALS). Members of an ALS are automatically members of the At-Large community.

citations.locator: section '1. Become a member of an accredited At-Large Structure (ALS)'
citations.quote: If you are a member of an accredited ALS, you are automatically a member of the At-Large Community.

text.id: Organisasi juga bisa mendaftar sebagai ALS baru. Perorangan bisa menjadi anggota individu tanpa ALS, tetapi hanya di wilayah tertentu.
text.en: An organization can apply to become a new ALS. An individual can also join without an ALS, but individual membership is only accepted in certain regions.

citations.quote: You may become an individual member of the At-Large Community without affiliation with an ALS. Individual membership is only accepted in certain regions.

text.id: Lima RALO (AFRALO, APRALO, EURALO, LACRALO, NARALO) menghimpun anggota At-Large per wilayah dan menjadi forum utama masukan publik di wilayahnya.
text.en: The five RALOs (AFRALO, APRALO, EURALO, LACRALO, NARALO) group At-Large members by region and are each region's main forum for public input.

citations.quote: There shall be one RALO for each Geographic Region established according to Section 7.5. Each RALO shall serve as the main forum and coordination point for public input to ICANN in its Geographic Region
The five RALOs unite our At-Large Structures (ALSes) and individual members based on their geographic regions.

text.id: Bylaws ICANN mewajibkan satu RALO untuk setiap Geographic Region. Sebuah organisasi baru diakui sebagai RALO setelah menandatangani Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) dengan ICANN.
text.en: The ICANN Bylaws require one RALO for each Geographic Region. An organization becomes the recognized RALO for its region once it signs a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with ICANN.

citations.quote: An organization shall become the recognized RALO for its Geographic Region upon entering a Memorandum of Understanding with ICANN

text.id: Menyebarkan informasi dari ICANN ke anggota, mendorong partisipasi mereka, dan menyalurkan sudut pandang pengguna di wilayahnya kepada ICANN.
text.en: Passes ICANN information to members, promotes their participation, and channels the regional user point of view to ICANN.

citations.quote: RALOs disseminate information from ICANN, promote the participation of their members, and channel the regional user point of view to ICANN.

text.id: Memilih 2 dari 15 anggota ALAC, sehingga kelima RALO bersama-sama mengisi 10 kursi ALAC. Satu anggota per RALO mulai masa jabatan di tahun genap, satu lagi di tahun ganjil.
text.en: Each RALO selects 2 of the 15 ALAC members, so the five together fill 10 ALAC seats. One member per RALO starts a term in an even-numbered year and the other in an odd-numbered year.

citations.quote: two members selected by each of the Regional At-Large Organizations
The term of the other member selected by each RALO shall begin at the conclusion of an ICANN annual meeting in an odd-numbered year.

text.id: Bersama ALAC, memberi masukan atas sertifikasi At-Large Structure di wilayahnya. Syarat sertifikasi ditulis dalam MoU tiap RALO dengan ICANN.
text.en: Take part with the ALAC in certifying At-Large Structures in their region. The certification criteria are written into each RALO's MoU with ICANN.

citations.quote: shall be stated in the Memorandum of Understanding between ICANN and the RALO for each Geographic Region.

text.id: Setiap RALO terdiri dari At-Large Structure (ALS) di wilayahnya yang telah disertifikasi. Jika MoU-nya mengizinkan, RALO juga boleh memuat pengguna internet individu. APRALO mencakup Asia, Australasia, dan Kepulauan Pasifik, dan halaman APRALO menyebut lebih dari 60 ALS di lebih dari 30 negara dan wilayah, serta lebih dari 40 anggota individu.
text.en: Each RALO is made up of certified At-Large Structures (ALSes) in its region. If its MoU allows, a RALO may also include individual Internet users. APRALO covers Asia, Australasia, and the Pacific Islands, and its page lists over 60 ALSes in over 30 countries and territories plus over 40 individual members.

citations.quote: Each RALO shall be comprised of self-supporting At-Large Structures within its Geographic Region that have been certified
Asian, Australasian, and Pacific Islands Regional At-Large Organization (APRALO)
APRALO consists of over 60 ALSes located in over 30 countries and territories, as well as over 40 Individual Members

text.id: APRALO punya tim kepemimpinan yang dipublikasikan: Ketua Amrita Choudhury, dua Wakil Ketua, serta dua anggota ALAC dari APRALO (Satish Babu dan Aftab Siddiqui) dan seorang Wakil Ketua ALAC (Justine Chew). Ini contoh bagaimana satu RALO mengisi kursi ALAC dan peran pimpinan.
text.en: APRALO publishes its leadership team: Chair Amrita Choudhury, two Vice-Chairs, two ALAC members from APRALO (Satish Babu and Aftab Siddiqui) and an ALAC Vice Chair (Justine Chew). It is a concrete case of one RALO filling its ALAC seats.

citations.quote: Amrita Choudhury , Chair
Satish Babu , ALAC Member

text.id: Di APRALO, orang yang tidak punya ALS di wilayahnya bisa menjadi anggota individu. Syaratnya: berlangganan milis apac-discuss@icann.org, menjadi penduduk tetap di salah satu negara atau wilayah APRALO menurut definisi ICANN, dan bukan anggota ALS terakreditasi.
text.en: In APRALO, someone with no accredited ALS where they live can become an individual member. The criteria: be subscribed to the apac-discuss@icann.org mailing list, be a permanent resident of a country or territory in the APRALO region as defined by ICANN, and not be a member of an accredited ALS.

citations.quote: you can become an individual member (also called 'unaffiliated individual member') in APRALO.
Not be a member of an accredited ALS;

text.id: Cara lain: menjadi anggota ALS APRALO yang sudah ada, atau mengakreditasi organisasimu sendiri sebagai ALS baru. Halaman At-Large menyediakan formulir dan daftar ALS.
text.en: Other routes: join an existing APRALO ALS, or apply to accredit your own organization as a new ALS. The At-Large site has the application forms and the ALS list.

citations.locator: section '2. Accredit your organization as a new At-Large Structure (ALS)'
citations.quote: Apply to accredit your own organization as an ALS, and all the members in your organization will become members of the At-Large community.

text.id: GAC adalah suara pemerintah dan organisasi antarpemerintah di ICANN, dan memberi nasihat kepada Dewan tentang kebijakan publik.
text.en: The GAC is the voice of governments and intergovernmental organizations in ICANN and advises the Board on public policy.

citations.quote: The GAC constitutes the voice of Governments and Intergovernmental Organizations (IGOs) in ICANN's multistakeholder structure.

text.id: Bylaws ICANN meminta GAC menimbang dan memberi nasihat tentang kegiatan ICANN yang berkaitan dengan kepentingan pemerintah, terutama saat kebijakan ICANN bersinggungan dengan hukum dan perjanjian internasional atau menyangkut kebijakan publik.
text.en: The ICANN Bylaws ask the GAC to consider and advise on ICANN activities that relate to governments' concerns, particularly where ICANN policies interact with laws and international agreements or affect public policy issues.

citations.quote: should consider and provide advice on the activities of ICANN as they relate to concerns of governments, particularly matters where there may be an interaction between ICANN's policies and various laws and international agreements

text.id: Menyampaikan isu kepada Dewan secara langsung, baik berupa komentar, nasihat awal, maupun rekomendasi tindakan atau perubahan kebijakan. Nasihat GAC dikirim lewat Communique atau Correspondence.
text.en: Puts issues to the Board directly, as comments, prior advice, or recommendations for action or policy change. GAC advice reaches the Board through a Communique or a piece of Correspondence.

citations.quote: may put issues to the Board directly, either by way of comment or prior advice, or by way of specifically recommending action or new policy development or revision to existing policies.

text.id: Nasihat yang disepakati konsensus penuh GAC (GAC Consensus Advice) hanya bisa ditolak Dewan dengan suara minimal 60%. Setelah itu GAC dan Dewan berusaha mencari solusi yang bisa diterima kedua pihak. Nasihat tanpa konsensus tetap harus dipertimbangkan, dan jika Dewan tidak mengikutinya, Dewan menyampaikan alasannya.
text.en: Advice approved by full GAC consensus (GAC Consensus Advice) can only be rejected by a vote of at least 60% of the Board, after which the GAC and the Board try to find a mutually acceptable solution. Other GAC advice must still be duly taken into account, and if the Board does not follow it, the Board states why.

citations.quote: may only be rejected by a vote of no less than 60% of the Board, and the Governmental Advisory Committee and the Board will then try, in good faith

text.id: Setiap tahun menunjuk satu Liaison ke Dewan dan satu liaison tanpa hak suara ke Nominating Committee. GAC juga boleh menunjuk liaison tanpa hak suara ke Council SO dan AC lain.
text.en: Each year appoints one Liaison to the Board and one non-voting liaison to the Nominating Committee. It may also designate non-voting liaisons to the SO Councils and other ACs.

citations.quote: shall annually appoint one Liaison to the Board, without limitation on reappointment, and shall annually appoint one non-voting liaison to the ICANN Nominating Committee.

text.id: Keanggotaan terbuka bagi semua pemerintah nasional, dan bagi Distinct Economies serta organisasi antarpemerintah atas undangan GAC melalui Chair-nya. Situs GAC menyebut 185 pemerintah anggota dan 41 organisasi pengamat. Indonesia tercantum dalam daftar anggota GAC, diwakili Direktur Jenderal Pengawasan Ruang Digital.
text.en: Membership is open to all national governments, and to Distinct Economies and multinational governmental organizations on the GAC's invitation through its Chair. The GAC site states 185 Member governments and 41 Observer organizations. Indonesia is on the GAC member list, represented by the Director General for Digital Space Monitoring.

citations.quote: Membership in the Governmental Advisory Committee shall be open to all national governments.
There are 185 Member governments and 41 Observer organizations in the GAC.
Indonesia Representative Alexander Sabar Director General, Digital Space Monitoring

text.id: Pada 20 Maret 2023, lewat Communique ICANN76 Cancun, GAC menyampaikan Consensus Advice kepada Dewan tentang perlindungan nama dan akronim organisasi antarpemerintah (IGO). GAC meminta Dewan melanjutkan persetujuan rekomendasi EPDP tentang Specific Curative Rights Protections, dan mempertahankan moratorium pendaftaran akronim IGO sebagai nama domain di gTLD baru sampai rekomendasi itu diterapkan penuh. Halaman GAC mencatat status konsensusnya: Consensus met.
text.en: On 20 March 2023, through the ICANN76 Cancun Communique, the GAC gave the Board Consensus Advice on protecting the names and acronyms of intergovernmental organizations (IGOs). It advised the Board to proceed with approving the EPDP recommendations on Specific Curative Rights Protections, and to maintain the moratorium on registering IGO acronyms as domain names in new gTLDs until those recommendations are fully implemented. The GAC page records the consensus status as: Consensus met.

citations.quote: 20 Mar 2023 via : ICANN76 Cancun Communique
Consensus met
The GAC advises the Board: i. To proceed with the approval of the recommendations of the EPDP on Specific Curative Rights Protections for implementation

To maintain the current moratorium on the registration of IGO acronyms as domain names in New gTLDs presently in place until the full implementation of the recommendations of the EPDP on Specific Curative Rights Protections.

text.id: GAC hanya untuk pemerintah dan lembaga publik: pemerintah nasional, organisasi antarpemerintah dan perjanjian, atau otoritas publik. Pemerintah yang belum menjadi anggota bisa mengikuti prosedur di halaman Join GAC. Tidak ada biaya keanggotaan.
text.en: The GAC is for governments and public bodies only: national governments, multinational governmental and treaty organizations, or public authorities. A government that is not yet a member can follow the application process on the Join the GAC page. There are no membership fees.

citations.quote: Membership in the GAC is reserved for national governments, multinational governmental organizations and treaty organizations, or public authorities.
There are no membership fees or charges.

text.id: Orang di luar pemerintah tidak bisa menjadi anggota, tetapi bisa menghadiri rapat GAC atau mengikutinya secara daring. Menurut GAC, semua sesi GAC terbuka bagi peserta, termasuk sesi penyusunan Communique.
text.en: People outside government cannot join, but anyone can attend a GAC meeting or follow it online. According to the GAC, all GAC sessions are open to participants, including the Communique drafting session.

citations.quote: All GAC sessions are open to participants, including the Communiqué drafting session

text.id: SSAC adalah kelompok sukarelawan ahli keamanan teknis yang menasihati komunitas dan Dewan ICANN soal keamanan sistem nama dan alamat internet.
text.en: The SSAC is a volunteer group of technical security specialists advising the ICANN community and Board on the security of Internet naming and addressing.

citations.quote: The SSAC advises the ICANN community and the ICANN Board on matters relating to the security and integrity of the naming and address allocation systems of the Internet.
volunteer group of specialists in the technical security field that provides advice and insight to the ICANN community and the Board.

text.id: Bylaws ICANN menetapkan SSAC untuk memberi nasihat kepada komunitas dan Dewan tentang keamanan dan integritas sistem penamaan dan alokasi alamat internet.
text.en: The ICANN Bylaws set up the SSAC to advise the community and the Board on the security and integrity of the Internet's naming and address allocation systems.

citations.quote: is to advise the ICANN community and Board on matters relating to the security and integrity of the Internet's naming and address allocation systems.

text.id: Melakukan penilaian ancaman dan analisis risiko secara berkelanjutan terhadap layanan penamaan dan alokasi alamat, lalu menyarankan audit yang diperlukan.
text.en: Carries out ongoing threat assessment and risk analysis of naming and address allocation services, and recommends any audits needed.

citations.quote: To engage in ongoing threat assessment and risk analysis of the Internet naming and address allocation services

text.id: Berkomunikasi dengan pihak yang bertanggung jawab langsung atas keamanan, yaitu IETF, RSSAC, RIR, dan registry nama, agar nasihatnya selaras dengan kegiatan standardisasi dan operasional yang berjalan.
text.en: Communicates with those directly responsible for security, namely the IETF, RSSAC, RIRs, and name registries, so its advice stays in step with ongoing standardization and operational work.

citations.quote: (IETF, RSSAC (as defined in Section 12.2(c)(i)), RIRs, name registries, etc.)

text.id: Melapor berkala kepada Dewan dan membuat rekomendasi kebijakan untuk komunitas dan Dewan. Hasilnya terbit sebagai dokumen bernomor SAC.
text.en: Reports periodically to the Board and makes policy recommendations to the community and the Board. Its output is published as numbered SAC documents.

citations.quote: To make policy recommendations to the ICANN community and Board.
SSAC Comments on the Initial Report of the GNSO DNS Abuse Mitigation Policy Development Process 1

text.id: Ketua dan anggota SSAC ditunjuk oleh Dewan, untuk masa jabatan tiga tahun yang bisa diperpanjang tanpa batas. Anggota bekerja sebagai individu, bukan wakil perusahaan atau lembaga asalnya. Halaman SSAC tidak menyebut jumlah anggota.
text.en: The SSAC's chair and members are appointed by the Board for three-year terms that can be renewed without limit. Members serve as individuals, not as representatives of their employers or other organizations. The SSAC page does not state a member count.

citations.quote: The SSAC's chair and members shall be appointed by the Board. SSAC membership appointment shall be for a three-year term
SSAC members participate in the SSAC as individuals, not as representatives of their employers or other organizations, and as equals.

text.id: SAC127, "DNS Blocking Revisited" (16 Mei 2025), laporan SSAC tentang pemblokiran DNS.
text.en: SAC127, "DNS Blocking Revisited" (16 May 2025), an SSAC report on DNS blocking.

citations.quote: DNS Blocking Revisited (pdf, 5.25 MB) Additional Documents: Executive Summary (16 May 2025)

text.id: Calon anggota mengirim aplikasi (CV, pernyataan minat, dan tautan karya yang opsional) lewat SSAC Application Form. Aplikasi ditinjau sekaligus setelah batas waktu, bukan bergilir. Batas waktu terbaru ada di halaman SSAC.
text.en: Candidates submit an application (CV, a statement of interest, and optional links to work) through the SSAC Application Form. Applications are reviewed together after the application deadline, not on a rolling basis. The current deadline is on the SSAC page.

citations.quote: Applications are reviewed collectively following this deadline; they are not considered on a rolling basis.
Your resume or CV A concise statement of interest outlining your motivation for joining and how you can contribute Links to relevant work, such as presentations or publications (optional)

text.id: Tanpa melamar, kamu bisa menghadiri sesi SSAC yang terbuka saat pertemuan ICANN untuk bertemu anggota dan melihat diskusinya.
text.en: Without applying, you can attend open SSAC sessions at ICANN meetings to meet members and follow the discussion.

citations.quote: attend open SSAC sessions during ICANN meetings

text.id: RSSAC memberi nasihat kepada komunitas dan Dewan ICANN tentang operasi, administrasi, keamanan, dan integritas Root Server System.
text.en: The RSSAC advises the ICANN community and Board on the operation, administration, security, and integrity of the Root Server System.

citations.quote: The RSSAC advises the ICANN community and the Board on matters relating to the operation, administration, security, and integrity of the Root Server System.

text.id: Bylaws ICANN menetapkan RSSAC untuk memberi nasihat tentang operasi, administrasi, keamanan, dan integritas Root Server System kepada komunitas dan Dewan.
text.en: The ICANN Bylaws set up the RSSAC to advise the community and the Board on the operation, administration, security, and integrity of the Root Server System.

citations.quote: is to advise the ICANN community and Board on matters relating to the operation, administration, security, and integrity of the Internet's Root Server System.

text.id: Berkomunikasi dengan komunitas teknis internet dan komunitas ICANN tentang operasi root server beserta instansinya, serta menyusun kebutuhan untuk pihak yang merevisi protokol dan praktik terbaik server DNS.
text.en: Communicates with the Internet technical community and the ICANN community about the operation of root servers and their instances, and gathers requirements for those revising protocols and best practices for DNS servers.

citations.quote: Communicate on matters relating to the operation of the Root Servers and their multiple instances with the Internet technical community and the ICANN community.

text.id: Melakukan penilaian ancaman dan analisis risiko terhadap Root Server System, serta menjawab permintaan informasi atau pendapat dari Dewan.
text.en: Carries out threat assessment and risk analysis of the Root Server System, and responds to requests for information or opinions from the Board.

citations.quote: Respond to requests for information or opinions from the Board.

text.id: Menerbitkan advisory, komentar, pernyataan, dan prosedur dengan nomor RSSAC. Contohnya RSSAC001 (harapan layanan operator root server) dan RSSAC 062 (pelaporan insiden keamanan).
text.en: Publishes numbered RSSAC advisories, comments, statements, and procedures. Examples are RSSAC001 (service expectations of root server operators) and RSSAC 062 (security incident reporting).

citations.quote: Security Incident Reporting (pdf, 310.84 KB) RSSAC 062 Advisory 6 May 2025

text.id: RSSAC terdiri dari perwakilan organisasi operator root server dan liaison dari organisasi mitra yang terlibat dalam pengelolaan teknis dan operasional root zone. Masa jabatan anggota tiga tahun, dan Dewan menerima rekomendasi RSSAC untuk Chair. Jumlah anggota tidak disebut di halaman RSSAC.
text.en: The RSSAC consists of representatives from the root server operator organizations and liaisons from partner organizations involved in the technical and operational management of the root zone. Member terms are three years, and the RSSAC recommends its chair to the Board. The RSSAC page does not state a member count.

citations.quote: consists of representatives from the root server operator organizations and liaisons from the partner organizations involved in the technical and operational management of the root zone.
RSSAC membership appointment shall be for a three-year term
The RSSAC shall recommend the appointment of the chair to the Board following a nomination process that it devises and documents.

text.id: RSSAC 063, "Statement on the Governance Working Group's Root Server System Governance Structure" (25 September 2025), pernyataan RSSAC tentang struktur tata kelola Root Server System.
text.en: RSSAC 063, "Statement on the Governance Working Group's Root Server System Governance Structure" (25 September 2025), an RSSAC statement on the governance structure of the Root Server System.

citations.quote: Statement on the Governance Working Group’s Root Server System Governance Structure (pdf, 64.32 KB) RSSAC 063 Comment 25 Sep 2025

text.id: Ahli DNS bisa melamar ke RSSAC Caucus dengan mengirim pernyataan minat ke RSSAC Caucus Membership Committee, memuat bidang kerja yang diminati dan keahlian. Komite menilai pengetahuan DNS, pengalaman di komunitas DNS, dan komitmen berpartisipasi. Caucus menyusun riset dan publikasi untuk RSSAC.
text.en: DNS experts can apply to the RSSAC Caucus by sending a statement of interest to the RSSAC Caucus Membership Committee, naming preferred work areas and relevant expertise. The committee weighs DNS knowledge, experience in the DNS community, and commitment to participate. The Caucus does research and produces publications for the RSSAC.

citations.quote: Interested parties can apply for membership in the RSSAC Caucus by submitting a statement of interest to the RSSAC Caucus Membership Committee.
The primary role of the RSSAC Caucus is to perform research and produce publications on topics relevant to the mission of the RSSAC.

text.id: NomCom adalah komite independen yang memilih sebagian anggota Dewan ICANN dan Dewan PTI, serta anggota ALAC dan Council ccNSO dan GNSO.
text.en: The NomCom is an independent committee that selects some members of the ICANN Board and PTI Board, and members of the ALAC and the ccNSO and GNSO Councils.

citations.quote: The Nominating Committee (NomCom) is an independent committee tasked with selecting key ICANN leadership positions, including some members of the ICANN Board of Directors and the Public Technical Identifiers (PTI) Board

text.id: Bylaws membentuk NomCom untuk menominasikan semua Direktur kecuali Presiden dan Direktur yang dinominasikan Decisional Participant, serta dua direktur PTI.
text.en: The Bylaws create the NomCom to nominate all Directors except the President and those nominated by Decisional Participants, and two PTI directors.

citations.quote: responsible for nominating all Directors except the President and those Directors nominated by Decisional Participants; for nominating two directors of PTI

text.id: NomCom menominasikan delapan Direktur untuk Seat 1 sampai 8. Pemberitahuan nominasinya disampaikan kepada EC Administration, dan Empowered Community yang menetapkan para Direktur tersebut.
text.en: The NomCom nominates eight Directors for Seats 1 to 8. It notifies the EC Administration of its nominations, and the Empowered Community designates those Directors.

citations.quote: Eight Directors nominated by the Nominating Committee to be designated as Directors by the EC.
Notification of the Nominating Committee's Director nominations shall be given by the Nominating Committee Chair in writing to the EC Administration

text.id: Selain kursi Dewan ICANN, NomCom mengisi sejumlah kursi di Dewan PTI, At-Large Advisory Committee, serta Council ccNSO dan GNSO.
text.en: Besides ICANN Board seats, the NomCom fills a number of seats on the PTI Board, the At-Large Advisory Committee, and the ccNSO and GNSO Councils.

citations.locator: Getting to Know the Nominating Committee
citations.quote: The Nominating Committee (NomCom) is responsible for appointing a number of seats to the ICANN Board of Directors, the Public Technical Identifiers (PTI) Board, the At-Large Advisory Committee (ALAC), and the Councils of the Country Code Names Supporting Organization (ccNSO)

text.id: Dalam menominasikan Direktur, NomCom wajib memastikan Dewan memiliki setidaknya satu Direktur dari tiap Geographic Region ICANN. NomCom tidak boleh menominasikan Direktur yang membuat jumlah Direktur (di luar Presiden) dari satu region melebihi lima.
text.en: When nominating Directors, the NomCom must make sure the Board includes at least one Director from each ICANN Geographic Region. It may not nominate a Director whose designation would take the number of Directors (not counting the President) from one region above five.

citations.quote: the Nominating Committee shall ensure when it makes its nominations that the Board includes at least one Director who is from a country in each ICANN Geographic Region
whose designation would cause the total number of Directors (not including the President) from countries in any one Geographic Region to exceed five

text.id: Anggota NomCom tidak boleh dinominasikan ke posisi apa pun yang diisi NomCom sampai Rapat Tahunan ICANN yang bertepatan dengan atau setelah masa tugasnya di NomCom berakhir. Karyawan dan konsultan berbayar ICANN tidak boleh menjadi anggota NomCom.
text.en: NomCom members cannot be nominated to any position the NomCom fills until the ICANN annual meeting that coincides with or follows the end of their NomCom service. ICANN employees and paid consultants cannot serve on the NomCom.

citations.quote: No person who serves on the Nominating Committee in any capacity shall be eligible for nomination by any means to any position on the Board
No person who is an employee of or paid consultant to ICANN (including the Ombudsman) shall simultaneously serve in any of the Nominating Committee positions described in Section 8.2.

text.id: NomCom punya 18 delegasi dengan hak suara. Enam badan masing-masing memilih satu delegasi: Address Council ASO, Council ccNSO, GAC, SSAC, RSSAC, dan IETF. ALAC memilih lima delegasi. GNSO memilih tujuh delegasi: satu dari Registries Stakeholder Group, satu dari Registrars Stakeholder Group, dua dari Business Constituency, satu dari ISPCP, satu dari Intellectual Property Constituency, dan satu dari Non-Commercial Users Constituency. Chair dan Chair-Elect tanpa hak suara diangkat Dewan. Masa tugas delegasi dua tahun, maksimal dua periode, dan tidak boleh berturut-turut.
text.en: The NomCom has 18 voting delegates. Six bodies each select one: the ASO Address Council, the ccNSO Council, the GAC, the SSAC, the RSSAC and the IETF. The ALAC selects five. The GNSO selects seven: one from the Registries Stakeholder Group, one from the Registrars Stakeholder Group, two from the Business Constituency, one from the ISPCP, one from the Intellectual Property Constituency and one from the Non-Commercial Users Constituency. The Board appoints a non-voting Chair and Chair-Elect. Delegates serve two-year terms, at most two terms, and not consecutively.

citations.quote: One voting delegate each selected by the following entities:
Five voting delegates selected by the At-Large Advisory Committee
Seven voting delegates to the Nominating Committee shall be selected from the Generic Names Supporting Organization
A non-voting Chair, appointed by the Board;
The term for each voting delegate shall be a two-year term. No individual may serve as a delegate for more than two terms.

citations.locator: Getting to Know the Nominating Committee, How does the Nominating Committee operate?
citations.quote: The NomCom consists of 18 voting delegates along with three non-voting members of the leadership team.

text.id: Pada 12 Agustus 2026 NomCom 2026 mengumumkan tujuh pilihannya: Catherine Adeya (Afrika) dan Niel Harper (Amerika Latin dan Karibia) untuk Dewan ICANN, Tomslin Samme-Nlar (Afrika) untuk Dewan PTI, serta dua untuk ALAC dan masing-masing satu untuk Council ccNSO dan GNSO. Pada 21 Agustus 2026 EC Administration mengirim surat yang mengonfirmasi pilihan NomCom untuk Seat 7 dan Seat 8 Dewan. Mereka yang terpilih mulai menjabat di akhir ICANN87 pada Oktober 2026.
text.en: On 12 August 2026 the 2026 NomCom announced its seven selections: Catherine Adeya (Africa) and Niel Harper (Latin America and the Caribbean) for the ICANN Board, Tomslin Samme-Nlar (Africa) for the PTI Board, plus two for the ALAC and one each for the ccNSO and GNSO Councils. On 21 August 2026 the EC Administration sent letters confirming the NomCom's selections for Board Seats 7 and 8. Those selected begin their terms at the end of ICANN87 in October 2026.

citations.quote: its selections for seven key leadership positions within ICANN's Supporting Organizations and Advisory Committees, the Public Technical Identifiers (PTI) Board of Directors, and the ICANN Board of Directors

citations.locator: Announcement, ICANN Board of Directors table
citations.quote: Catherine Adeya Africa Niel Harper Latin America and the Caribbean
Those selected will begin their terms at the conclusion of the ICANN87 Annual General Meeting in October 2026.
Letter from ECA to ICANN Secretary Confirming the NomCom Selection for ICANN Board Seat 7

text.id: Siklus NomCom 2026 punya masa pendaftaran kandidat pada tahap Recruitment & Outreach, Desember 2025 sampai Februari 2026. Informasi pendaftaran siklus berikutnya ada di halaman NomCom.
text.en: The 2026 NomCom cycle had a candidate application period in its Recruitment & Outreach phase, December 2025 to February 2026. Application information for later cycles is on the NomCom page.
