text.id: Empowered Community (EC) adalah asosiasi nirlaba California yang terdiri atas lima Decisional Participant: ASO, ccNSO, GNSO, ALAC, dan GAC. EC memegang kekuasaan formal untuk mengawasi Dewan.
text.en: The Empowered Community (EC) is a California nonprofit association of five Decisional Participants: the ASO, ccNSO, GNSO, ALAC and GAC. It holds formal powers that can check the Board.

citations.quote: consisting of the ASO, the ccNSO (as defined in Section 10.1), the GNSO (as defined in Section 11.1), the ALAC (as defined in Section 12.2(d)(i)) and the GAC

text.id: Bylaws menyatakan satu-satunya tujuan EC adalah menjalankan hak dan kewajibannya berdasarkan Articles of Incorporation dan Bylaws ICANN. EC tidak punya kekuasaan atau hak lain di luar itu.
text.en: The Bylaws state that the EC's sole purpose is to exercise its rights and perform its obligations under ICANN's Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws. It has no other powers or rights.

citations.quote: The sole purpose of the EC is to exercise its rights and perform its obligations under ICANN's Articles of Incorporation and these Bylaws, and the EC shall have no other powers or rights except as expressly provided therein.

text.id: EC menunjuk dan memberhentikan Direktur secara individual (selain Presiden), dan dapat me-recall seluruh Dewan.
text.en: The EC appoints and removes individual Directors (other than the President) and can recall the entire Board.

citations.quote: Appoint and remove individual Directors (other than the President); (ii) Recall the entire Board;

text.id: EC dapat menolak ICANN Budget, IANA Budget, Operating Plan, Strategic Plan, perubahan Bylaws biasa (Standard Bylaw Amendments), dan PTI Governance Actions.
text.en: The EC can reject ICANN Budgets, IANA Budgets, Operating Plans, Strategic Plans, Standard Bylaw Amendments and PTI Governance Actions.

citations.quote: Reject ICANN Budgets, IANA Budgets, Operating Plans (as defined in Section 22.5(a)(i)) and Strategic Plans
Reject Standard Bylaw Amendments
Reject PTI Governance Actions

text.id: EC harus menyetujui Fundamental Bylaw Amendments, perubahan Articles of Incorporation, dan penjualan aset ICANN (Asset Sales) sebelum semuanya berlaku.
text.en: The EC must approve Fundamental Bylaw Amendments, Articles Amendments and Asset Sales.

citations.quote: Approve Fundamental Bylaw Amendments, Articles Amendments (as defined in Section 25.2(b)), and Asset Sales (as defined in Article 26(a));

text.id: EC dapat mengajukan Community Reconsideration Request, mediasi, atau Community IRP. EC juga dapat menggugat ke pengadilan untuk menegakkan haknya.
text.en: The EC can start a Community Reconsideration Request, mediation or a Community IRP. It can also sue in court to enforce its rights.

citations.quote: Initiate a Community Reconsideration Request, mediation or a Community IRP;
The EC may pursue an action in any court with jurisdiction over ICANN to enforce the EC's rights under these Bylaws.

text.id: Anggotanya adalah lima Decisional Participant: ASO, ccNSO, GNSO, ALAC, dan GAC. Mereka bertindak lewat EC Administration, yaitu ketua masing-masing atau orang yang mereka tunjuk. EC tidak punya direktur, officer, atau karyawan.
text.en: Its members are five Decisional Participants: the ASO, ccNSO, GNSO, ALAC and GAC. They act through the EC Administration, made up of their chairs or people they designate. The EC has no directors, officers or employees.

citations.quote: the ASO, the ccNSO (as defined in Section 10.1), the GNSO (as defined in Section 11.1), the ALAC (as defined in Section 12.2(d)(i)) and the GAC
The Decisional Participants shall act through their respective chairs or such other persons as may be designated by the Decisional Participants
nor have any directors, officers or employees

text.id: Pada Juli 2026 Dewan menyetujui Fundamental Bylaws Amendments terkait Customer Standing Committee dan IANA Naming Function Review. EC Administration menyetujuinya lewat surat bertanggal 3 Juli 2026. GAC mengirim surat abstain kepada EC Administration sehari sebelumnya, 2 Juli 2026. Bylaws yang berlaku saat ini bertanggal "As amended 3 July 2026".
text.en: In July 2026 the Board approved Fundamental Bylaws Amendments on the Customer Standing Committee and the IANA Naming Function Review. The EC Administration approved them by a letter dated 3 July 2026. The GAC sent the EC Administration a letter abstaining the day before, on 2 July 2026. The current Bylaws are dated "As amended 3 July 2026".

citations.quote: Letter from ECA to ICANN Secretary Approving the Fundamental Bylaws Amendments re Customer Standing Committee and IANA Naming Function Review
Letter from GAC to ECA Abstaining from the Fundamental Bylaws Amendments re Customer Standing Committee and IANA Naming Function Review
Notice of Board Approval of Fundamental Bylaws Amendments re Customer Standing Committee and IANA Naming Function Review
As amended 3 July 2026

text.id: Setiap Decisional Participant wajib menetapkan prosedur untuk petisi, termasuk cara seseorang mengajukan petisi kepadanya. Orang yang ingin mengangkat isu ke EC mulai dari prosedur ASO, ccNSO, GNSO, ALAC, atau GAC.
text.en: Each Decisional Participant must adopt procedures for petitions, including how an individual can submit a petition to it. Someone who wants to raise an issue with the EC starts with the procedures of the ASO, ccNSO, GNSO, ALAC or GAC.

citations.quote: the process for an individual to submit a petition to such Decisional Participant

text.id: PTI adalah badan hukum nirlaba afiliasi ICANN, dengan ICANN sebagai satu-satunya member. Tugas tunggalnya menjalankan fungsi IANA.
text.en: PTI is a nonprofit affiliate of ICANN, with ICANN as its sole member. Its sole purpose is to deliver the IANA functions.

citations.quote: PTI is an affiliate of the Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers (ICANN), with ICANN as its sole member. PTI's sole purpose is to deliver the IANA functions on behalf of ICANN

text.id: Bylaws mewajibkan ICANN memiliki PTI sebagai badan hukum California nirlaba yang terpisah, untuk menyediakan layanan IANA, termasuk fungsi penamaan IANA berdasarkan IANA Naming Function Contract.
text.en: The Bylaws require ICANN to keep PTI as a separate California nonprofit corporation that provides IANA services, including the IANA naming function under the IANA Naming Function Contract.

citations.quote: for the purpose of providing IANA services, including providing IANA naming function services pursuant to the IANA Naming Function Contract

text.id: PTI menjalankan fungsi IANA dalam tiga bidang: nama domain, sumber daya nomor, dan parameter protokol.
text.en: PTI performs the IANA functions in three areas: domain names, number resources and protocol parameter assignments.

citations.quote: The IANA functions are commonly grouped into three areas: domain names, number resources, and protocol parameter assignments.

text.id: Untuk fungsi penamaan, kewajiban ICANN disubkontrakkan ke PTI lewat perjanjian ICANN-PTI yang mengatur tingkat layanan dan kewajiban pengelolaan root zone. Bylaws menyebut kontrak ini IANA Naming Function Contract.
text.en: For the naming function, ICANN's obligations are subcontracted to PTI under an ICANN-PTI agreement that sets service levels and obligations for root zone management. The Bylaws call it the IANA Naming Function Contract.

citations.quote: ICANN's obligations for the IANA naming functions are subcontracted to PTI under the ICANN–PTI Naming Function Agreement
ICANN shall enter into a contract with PTI for the performance of the IANA naming function

text.id: Registri nomor global dipelihara berdasarkan service level agreement antara ICANN dan lima Regional Internet Registry, dan registri parameter protokol berdasarkan MoU antara ICANN dan IETF. Pelaksanaan keduanya disubkontrakkan ke PTI.
text.en: The global number registries are kept under a service level agreement between ICANN and the five Regional Internet Registries, and the protocol parameter registries under an MoU between ICANN and the IETF. Performance of both is subcontracted to PTI.

citations.quote: The global number registries are maintained under a service level agreement between ICANN and the five Regional Internet Registries, with performance subcontracted to PTI.
The protocol parameter registries are maintained under a Memorandum of Understanding between ICANN and the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF)

text.id: Dewan PTI mengurus tata kelola korporasi PTI: menyetujui rencana operasi dan anggaran tahunan PTI serta mengangkat officer-nya.
text.en: The PTI Board handles PTI's corporate governance: it approves PTI's annual operating plans and budgets and appoints its officers.

citations.quote: it approves PTI's annual operating plans and budgets, appoints its officers, and ensures the organization meets its legal and contractual obligations

text.id: ICANN adalah satu-satunya member PTI dan memilih direktur PTI sesuai anggaran dasar dan bylaws PTI. Dewan PTI menggabungkan direktur yang ditunjuk ICANN dengan direktur dari komunitas. Nominating Committee menominasikan dua direktur PTI. Resolusi Dewan ICANN tanggal 13 Desember 2017 menyebut Sec. 5.2.1 Bylaws PTI mengizinkan Dewan PTI punya lima direktur.
text.en: ICANN is PTI's sole member and elects PTI's directors under PTI's articles and bylaws. The PTI Board combines directors appointed by ICANN with directors drawn from the community. The Nominating Committee nominates two PTI directors. An ICANN Board resolution of 13 December 2017 states that Section 5.2.1 of the PTI Bylaws authorizes the PTI Board to have five Directors.

citations.quote: ICANN, in its capacity as the sole Member of PTI, shall elect the directors of PTI in accordance with the articles of incorporation and bylaws of PTI
The Board's membership combines directors appointed by ICANN with directors drawn from the community.
for nominating two directors of PTI (in accordance with the articles of incorporation and bylaws of PTI)

citations.locator: PTI Governance Items, PTI Board - Directors (Whereas clauses)
citations.quote: the PTI Bylaws, at Section 5.2.1, authorizes the PTI Board to have five Directors.

text.id: Pada 28 April 2025 Dewan PTI mengesahkan IANA 2030 Strategy, rencana strategis lima tahun dengan tiga fokus: inovasi, keunggulan operasional, dan keterlibatan komunitas. Dewan PTI juga mengesahkan Operating Plan dan Budget PTI untuk FY26.
text.en: On 28 April 2025 the PTI Board adopted the IANA 2030 Strategy, a five-year plan with three focus areas: innovation, operational excellence and community engagement. It also adopted PTI's FY26 Operating Plan and Budget.

citations.quote: The Public Technical Identifiers (PTI) Board is proud to present our IANA 2030 Strategy, which sets out objectives for the next five years.

citations.locator: Blog post, paragraph on focus areas
citations.quote: The IANA 2030 Strategy lays out three focus areas: innovation, operational excellence, and community engagement.
the PTI Board adopted the PTI FY26 Operating Plan and Budget

name.en: Regional Internet Registries (RIRs) and the NRO

text.id: Lima organisasi regional yang membagikan alamat IP dan nomor ASN di wilayahnya masing-masing. Koordinasi mereka dilakukan lewat Number Resource Organization (NRO).
text.en: Five regional organizations that hand out IP addresses and AS numbers in their own regions. They coordinate through the Number Resource Organization (NRO).

citations.quote: The Number Resource Organization (NRO) was established in 2003 as a coordinating body for the world's Regional Internet Registries (RIRs).
our primary role is to provide Internet number resources (IPv4, IPv6 and ASNs) to our Members in the Asia Pacific region.

text.id: NRO mengatakan misinya adalah menyediakan dan mempromosikan sistem registri nomor Internet yang terkoordinasi, serta mengoordinasikan dan mendukung kegiatan bersama kelima RIR.
text.en: The NRO states its mission as providing and promoting a coordinated Internet number registry system, and coordinating and supporting joint activities of the five RIRs.

citations.quote: Providing and promoting a coordinated Internet number registry system
Coordinating and supporting joint activities of the RIRs.

text.id: Setiap RIR menyediakan sumber daya nomor Internet (IPv4, IPv6, dan ASN) kepada anggotanya di wilayah yang dilayani. APNIC, misalnya, melayani Asia Pasifik.
text.en: Each RIR provides Internet number resources (IPv4, IPv6 and ASNs) to its members in its region. APNIC, for example, serves the Asia Pacific.

citations.quote: As the Regional Internet Registry for the Asia Pacific region, our primary role is to provide Internet number resources (IPv4, IPv6 and ASNs) to our Members in the Asia Pacific region.

text.id: NRO menjadi titik koordinasi untuk kegiatan dan proyek bersama para RIR, lewat Coordination Group di bidang Communications, Engineering, Registration Services, dan Executive.
text.en: The NRO is the coordination point for joint RIR activities and projects, through Coordination Groups for Communications, Engineering, Registration Services and Executive leadership.

citations.quote: The NRO is a coordination point for joint RIR activities and projects
facilitates several Coordination Groups in the areas of Communications, Engineering, Registration Services and Executive leadership.

text.id: Kebijakan alamat APNIC dibahas di Policy SIG. Siapa pun boleh mengusulkan dan membahas kebijakan, sebagian besar lewat milis, dan hasilnya diputuskan dalam Open Policy Meeting dua kali setahun.
text.en: APNIC's address policies are developed in the Policy SIG. Anyone can propose and discuss policies, mostly on a mailing list, and outcomes are decided at an Open Policy Meeting twice a year.

citations.quote: Two times each year the SIG holds a face-to-face Open Policy Meeting to decide the outcomes by trying to reach consensus on the policy changes proposed.

text.id: Organisasi pengembang standar Internet yang terbuka untuk siapa saja. Standar protokolnya menjadi dasar registri parameter protokol yang dikelola IANA.
text.en: The open standards body for the Internet. Its protocol standards are the basis for the protocol parameter registries IANA maintains.

citations.quote: The Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF), founded in 1986, is the premier standards development organization (SDO) for the Internet.
we provide this service in coordination with the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF).

text.id: IETF didirikan pada 1986 sebagai organisasi pengembang standar (SDO) untuk Internet.
text.en: The IETF was founded in 1986 as a standards development organization (SDO) for the Internet.

citations.quote: The Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF), founded in 1986, is the premier standards development organization (SDO) for the Internet.

text.id: Pekerjaan resmi IETF berlangsung di working group, terutama lewat milis masing-masing. Selain itu ada tiga pertemuan seminggu penuh setiap tahun.
text.en: IETF work is done in working groups, mainly on their own mailing lists. There are also three week-long meetings each year.

citations.quote: all of it official work, conducted on this list.

text.id: IANA hanya memberi dan mencatat parameter protokol Internet sesuai kriteria dan prosedur yang ditetapkan dalam RFC. Jika IANA dan IESG berselisih secara teknis, keduanya meminta panduan IAB, dan keputusan IAB bersifat final (RFC 2860, bagian 4).
text.en: IANA assigns and registers Internet protocol parameters only as directed by the criteria and procedures in RFCs. If IANA and the IESG have a technical dispute, both seek guidance from the IAB, whose decision is final (RFC 2860, section 4).

citations.quote: The IANA will assign and register Internet protocol parameters only as directed by the criteria and procedures specified in RFCs
In the event of technical dispute between the IANA and the IESG, both will seek guidance from the IAB whose decision shall be final.

text.id: Internet Architecture Board (IAB) bertanggung jawab atas administrasi penetapan nilai parameter protokol IETF oleh IANA, dan menunjuk liaison IETF untuk Dewan ICANN.
text.en: The Internet Architecture Board (IAB) is responsible for administering the assignment of IETF protocol parameter values by IANA, and appoints the IETF liaison to the ICANN Board.

citations.quote: The IAB is responsible for administration of the assignment of IETF Protocol parameter values by the IETF Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA).
The Internet Architecture Board (IAB) appoints a liaison to represent the IETF on the ICANN Board of Directors.

text.id: IETF tidak punya keanggotaan. Siapa pun bisa berpartisipasi dengan bergabung ke milis working group atau mendaftar ke pertemuan IETF.
text.en: There is no membership in the IETF. Anyone can take part by joining a working group mailing list or registering for an IETF meeting.

citations.quote: There is no membership in the IETF. Anyone can participate by signing up to a working group mailing list (more on that below), or registering for an IETF meeting.

text.id: RFC 2860 (Juni 2000) adalah nota kesepahaman antara IETF dan ICANN tentang pekerjaan teknis IANA. RFC itu juga memberi IANA kursi liaison tanpa hak suara di komite IETF yang relevan.
text.en: RFC 2860 (June 2000) is the memorandum of understanding between the IETF and ICANN on IANA's technical work. It also gives IANA non-voting liaison seats on appropriate IETF committees.

citations.quote: The IANA shall have non-voting liaison seats on appropriate IETF committees as determined by the IETF

text.id: Tidak perlu mendaftar sebagai anggota: cukup bergabung ke milis working group atau mendaftar ke pertemuan IETF.
text.en: No membership is needed: sign up to a working group mailing list or register for an IETF meeting.

text.en: root-servers.org describes the root server system as 13 identities (A to M) run by 12 independent organizations, and links operator commitment documents such as RFC 7720 and RSSAC055. The page does not explain why each operator was set up.

The 13 root name servers are operated by 12 independent organisations.

text.en: Operators run the root servers that serve the DNS root zone. IANA describes this as a network of hundreds of servers in many countries.

citations.quote: The authoritative name servers that serve the DNS root zone, often known simply as the “root servers”, are a network of hundreds of servers in many countries around the world.
